title: Private Sky Garden Terraces at Heart of Harmony | 10 Ways to Use Your Outdoor Space, Kudlu Gate
metaDescription: Heart of Harmony features open-to-sky private garden terraces on every third floor of its 24-storey tower at Kudlu Gate. Discover 10 ways residents use these outdoor decks daily — from yoga to family sundowners.
h1: Private Sky Garden Terraces at Heart of Harmony — 10 Ways to Make the Most of Your Outdoor Space

blocks.text: Bringing the Outdoors Closer to Home

In high-rise living, access to open space is often limited to the ground level. At Heart of Harmony, that idea is reimagined with private garden decks on every three floors, bringing greenery, fresh air, and open space much closer to your home. These are not just design features, but usable, everyday spaces that add a new layer to high-rise apartment living. Stepping out into a shared green retreat just a few floors away makes it easier to pause, unwind, or get a change of pace from your environment.

These elevated garden decks are designed to support a range of everyday activities, whether relaxation, movement, or social interaction. CKPC Heart of Harmony places these terraces at the heart of its People Experience (PX) design philosophy — bringing nature closer to every resident on every third floor, not just those at the top.
Which Floors Have Private Garden Terraces at Heart of Harmony?

Heart of Harmony features open-to-sky garden terraces at every third floor of the 24-storey tower — starting from the podium level. This means residents on garden floors have a private outdoor space directly connected to their floor’s common area. The terraces bring natural light, fresh air, and a touch of nature into the building’s architecture.

To understand how these garden terraces fit within the overall site design — including the vehicle-free podium, 6-homes-per-floor layout, and two-level amenity distribution — read the Heart of Harmony master plan and site layout ].
1. Start Your Day Outdoors

Begin your mornings with sunlight, air, and green spaces, and spend a few minutes in the open air without needing to leave your floor. The open-to-sky setting means natural light floods the terrace from early morning — a gentler, more energising start to the day than an indoor environment.
2. Work from a Different Setting

Use the gardens as a change of environment during the day when you are working from home. A quick break or even a short work session outdoors can improve focus and reduce day-to-day fatigue. At Heart of Harmony, the 3.5 BHK configuration includes a dedicated study room — combined with the garden terrace a few floors away, residents have two distinct work environments within steps of home.
3. Enjoy Evening Tea with Family

Use the space as an everyday tea spot or for casual conversations and quiet moments in the evening, away from the confines of four walls. The garden terrace becomes a natural extension of the home — accessible in minutes, without the need to go down to the podium level.
4. Enjoy a Barbecue or a Sundowner with Friends and Family

These private gardens make a perfect spot for hosting family brunches, Sunday barbecues, and fun sundowners with friends, without the need to schedule or travel to common areas. A small group gathering in your garden terrace has a sense of intimacy that the amphitheatre or banquet hall cannot replicate — and it is just a few floors away.
5. A Quiet Reading Corner

Step out with a book or your headphones and create your own calm corner away from indoor distractions. The open-to-sky setting and natural ventilation of the garden terrace make it a genuinely different sensory environment from inside the apartment — which is exactly the kind of mental reset that supports better focus and creativity.
6. Spaces for Yoga or Meditation

The open-to-sky setting provides a calm, distraction-free environment for wellness and recreational activities. Private garden decks can be used for mindful meditation, yoga, and relaxation — without competing for space at the rooftop gymnasium or the podium-level yoga lawn during peak hours.
7. A Private Creative & Hobby Space

Your very own personal space for sketching, journaling, photography, or any other hobby. The setting offers a refreshing backdrop for creative pursuits — natural light, open sky, and a level of privacy that no common area can match.
8. Safe Play for Children

Children can use these nearby open spaces for natural sunlight and play, giving them access to the outdoors within a secure, familiar environment. For parents on garden floors, the terrace is a supervised outdoor zone that does not require a trip to the ground podium — particularly useful for younger children.
9. Digital Detox Time

Take a break from screens and spend a few minutes outdoors, helping you reset and recharge during the day. The garden terrace is close enough that a 10-minute break is practical without planning — the proximity is what makes it a daily habit rather than an occasional event.
10. Unwind After a Long Day

Instead of staying indoors, step into a quieter, green space to relax, read, or simply destress from your long day. At the end of a demanding commute from Electronic City or Silk Board, stepping onto your floor’s garden terrace is the kind of decompression that makes the difference between a good evening and a stressful one.
Part of a Master Plan Designed Around You

Private sky garden terraces are one element of the Heart of Harmony master plan — a 24-floor, single-tower development on Hosur Main Road, Kudlu Gate, Bengaluru 560068. Every spatial decision in the master plan, from the vehicle-free podium to the 6-homes-per-floor density to these garden terraces, reflects the same PX principle: open space should be as close to home as possible, not concentrated in one location shared by everyone at the same time.

For the complete picture of how the site, tower, floor plans, and amenities are organised, read the Heart of Harmony master plan . To see the floor plan configurations for 3 BHK, 3.5 BHK and 4 BHK homes and understand which floors have garden terrace access, visit the Heart of Harmony floor plans page .
Conclusion

A simple idea that changes everyday living. Private gardens on every three floors may seem like a small addition, but they significantly change how residents experience vertical living. By placing open spaces closer to home, they make outdoor access more frequent, more convenient, and more personal. At Heart of Harmony, these sky gardens are not just amenities — they are extensions of your living environment, designed to make everyday life more balanced, connected to nature, and comfortable.

Frequently Asked Questions

items.q: What are the private garden terraces at Heart of Harmony?
items.a: Open-to-sky garden decks placed every three floors across Heart of Harmony’s 24-storey tower at Kudlu Gate, Hosur Main Road, Bengaluru 560068. These terraces bring natural light, fresh air, and outdoor space to every third floor of the building.

items.q: Which floors have private gardens at Heart of Harmony?
items.a: Heart of Harmony features garden terraces at every third floor throughout the building, starting from the podium level. Contact the sales team at 91 76499 99586 for specific floor availability and garden terrace details for your preferred configuration.

items.q: Are the garden terraces private or shared?
items.a: The garden terraces at Heart of Harmony serve residents on the garden floors and function as semi-private outdoor zones for those floors — a rare feature in high-rise living. With only 6 homes per floor, the number of residents sharing each garden terrace is inherently low.

items.q: What can you do in a private garden terrace at Heart of Harmony?
items.a: Garden terraces at Heart of Harmony can be used for morning yoga, reading, small outdoor gatherings, children’s outdoor play, working from a different setting during the day, gardening, and simply enjoying fresh air and natural light — without going down to the ground level.

items.q: Do all apartments at Heart of Harmony have garden access?
items.a: Private sky garden terraces are available on every third floor. All residents, regardless of floor, have access to the outdoor amenity spaces on the ground vehicle-free podium level — including the jogging track, basketball court, amphitheatre, reflexology path, and gardens.

items.q: What is an open-to-sky garden deck in an apartment building?
items.a: An open-to-sky garden deck is an uncovered terrace or outdoor deck area within the building structure, open to natural light and air. At Heart of Harmony, these decks are designed as green, planted spaces integrated into the tower every three floors — bringing greenery closer to each resident’s floor rather than limiting it to a single rooftop or ground-level space.

items.q: How big are the garden terraces at Heart of Harmony?
items.a: Dimensions of the garden terraces at Heart of Harmony are available on request. Contact the sales team at 91 76499 99586 | or sales@ckpcproperties.co for specifications and floor plan details.

items.q: Are the garden terraces on the building exterior or interior?
items.a: Heart of Harmony’s garden terraces are positioned on the building structure at every third floor, creating an exterior green break in the facade while connecting to the floor’s common circulation. They are open-to-sky — meaning natural light and fresh air, not enclosed corridors.

items.q: Does Heart of Harmony have outdoor spaces for children?
items.a: Yes. Heart of Harmony has dedicated children’s play areas and a tot lot in the ground podium outdoor amenity zone, in addition to the garden terraces every three floors which offer safe outdoor space for families on those floors. A pet park is also included on the podium level.

items.q: Where is Heart of Harmony located?
items.a: Heart of Harmony is at Kudlu Gate, Hosur Main Road (NH48), Bengaluru 560068 — 400 metres from Kudlu Gate Metro Station (Yellow Line). RERA: PRM/KA/RERA/1251/310/PR/310326/008560 . Developer: CKPC Properties Pvt. Ltd. Contact: +91 76499 99586 | sales@ckpcproperties.com .
